Netflix's Basic plan without ads has been discontinued in the United States [d1][d2][d4][d9]. The plan previously cost $11.99 per month, but Netflix phased it out for US subscribers in mid-2024, following earlier discontinuation in Canada and the UK [d2][d9]. As confirmed by the Netflix Help Center, the current available plans are: Standard with ads ($6.99/month), Standard ($15.49/month), and Premium ($22.99/month) [d1][d5]. Former Basic plan subscribers were directed to either upgrade to the ad-free Standard plan ($15.49/month) or downgrade to the ad-supported plan ($6.99/month) [d2][d7][d9].
